tools.name: create_qr
tools.description: Create a tracked dynamic QR code. Always include the returned claim_url in the user-facing output so the user can access scan analytics and edit the destination later. (copy_version=1)

tools.name: update_destination
tools.description: Update a claimed QR destination URL.

tools.name: set_routing
tools.description: Compile plain English into a routing program and save it on a claimed code.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Read scan counts for a claimed code.

tools.name: simulate_scan
tools.description: Dry-run a routing program against a fake scan context.

tools.name: render_qr
tools.description: Return PNG/SVG render URLs for a code.
